name: Bee Hotel ICal
description: Exports a unit's availability as an iCal (.ics) feed so external calendars (Google, Airbnb, Booking.com) can consume it.
project_description: Bee Hotel ICal produces an iCal (.ics) availability feed per unit at /beehotel_ical/availability/{node}. Blocked/unavailable nights (whose BAT state is in a configurable blocking-status list) are emitted as VEVENTs so external calendars such as Google Calendar, Airbnb or Booking.com can import the property's availability. A settings form at /admin/config/services/beehotel_ical/settings configures which BAT statuses count as blocking.
